decisions.reason: As a certified gasketed plate heat exchanger closely aligned with the firm's core heat-transfer portfolio, it fits growing industrial and HVAC demand and is too strategically relevant to withdraw after only a short time on the market.
The marine box cooler system already shows clear market acceptance through its stated major market share in water cooling systems, making it a strong product to retain and support.
The marine cooling unit builds directly on established marine cooling know-how and having its own product page suggests it is an important offer worth developing further rather than dropping.
The compact oil cooler is a natural extension of the firm's existing industrial cooling range and supports its broad application coverage for demanding customer processes.
Finned tubes for air coolers strengthen the firm's component and aftermarket offering, matching its strategy of lifecycle support and continuous efficiency improvement for customers.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes leverage the firm's engineering and R&D capabilities and are consistent with its innovation-driven positioning in performance upgrades and tailored solutions.
